p: the collection for the saints: Collections in ancient times were made by the appointment of the apostle appointment to be the first day of the week, on which day the manner was then to assemble themselves.
first day of the week let: Which in times past was called Sunday, but now is called the Lord's day.
prospered him: That every man bestow according to the ability that God has blessed him with.
letters: Which you will give to them to carry.

And if it be meet that: The rest of the epistle is spent in writing of familiar matters, yet so that all things are referred to his purposed mark, that is to say, to the glory of God, and the edifying of the Corinthians.
effectual is opened unto me: Very fit and convenient to do great things by.
without fear: Without any just occasion of fear.
in peace: Safe and sound, and that with every type of courtesy.
Stephanas: Stephanas is the name of a man and not of a woman.
addicted themselves to the ministry of: Given themselves wholly to the ministry.

submit yourselves unto such: That you honour and revere them, be obedient to them, and be content to be ruled by them, as you properly should, seeing that they have bestowed themselves and their goods, and this to help you with them.
acknowledge ye them that are such: Take them for such men as they are indeed.

Maranatha: By these words are meant the severest type of curse and excommunication that was among the Jews: and the words are as much as to say, "As our Lord comes". So that his meaning may be this, "Let him be accursed even to the coming of the Lord", that is to say, to the day of his death, even for ever.
